description: Generate a production-ready custom patch design from a description (and optionally a reference image URL). Takes about 15 to 30 seconds and returns the design as an image plus a design id for edits and an order link. Previews carry a light PatchDesign.AI watermark; the clean file comes with an order. Say what the patch shows and any text on it, spelled exactly. To change a design already made in this chat, use edit_patch with its id. A chat gets 10 free designs, then the user signs in with the link from sign_in_link. If the result says the service was busy, call it once more with the same input.

description.description: What the patch should show: subject, colors, mood, and any lettering spelled exactly as it should appear. 3 to 1500 characters.

patchType.description: Patch type: embroidered (default), woven, chenille, printed, pvc-2d or pvc-3d. Iron-on, velcro and sew-on are backings on an embroidered patch, so use embroidered for those.

referenceImageUrl.description: Optional https URL of a logo, sketch or photo to base the patch on. With a reference, the description is guidance about how to adapt it.

name: design_patch
title: Design a custom patch
